history.content: Hey — good to see you. What’s been going on today?
idk. nothing really. just kind of a lot lately i guess
That sounds a bit like being in the middle of a lot, even if nothing specific is standing out. Does it feel more like pressure, or more like you’ve gone a bit flat?
pressure probably. like im supposed to have it together by now and i dont
That sounds really pressuring — like there’s an expectation hanging over you. Is it more the “supposed to” part, or the “I don’t” part?
the i dont part. everyone i grew up with has like. real careers. houses. and im 31 and still doing the same temp stuff i did at 24
That sounds heavy and comparing, like the gap itself is what’s stinging. Does it feel more like being behind, or like you’re getting measured against everyone else?
both. my sister just got engaged and bought a place and at the dinner everyone kept asking me what im doing and i just. didnt have an answer. felt like a kid at the adults table
That sounds like a mix of pressure and shame, with the dinner making it feel sharper. Did it leave you wanting to shrink, go quiet, or get out of there?
shrink. i just went quiet and helped clear plates so i didnt have to talk. like if im useful in the kitchen nobody asks the real questions
That makes sense — being useful in the kitchen gave you a way to disappear from the questions. Does it feel familiar, like a place you know how to go when things get too exposing?
yeah. ive done it my whole life. easier to be the one helping than the one being looked at. but then i go home and feel like garbage anyway
That sounds like a long-used way of staying out of view, even if it doesn’t protect you from the after-feeling. Does the “garbage” feel more like shame, disappointment, or something else?
disappointment in myself i think. like i had potential or whatever and i just. didnt do anything with it. ugh idk this is a lot. didnt mean to dump all this

That sounds like disappointment turning inward, and the “didn’t mean to dump all this” has a self-critical edge too. We can leave it here if you want, or stay with what this says about the “potential” part?
yeah lets leave it there. im kinda tired. thanks for listening tho. means more than youd think
Of course — we can leave it there. I’m glad you told me, and I’ll keep this thread in mind for next time.
